preprocessCodeCallbacks.description:
A list of callbacks to execute during the code preprocessing stage. These callbacks can modify or
validate the code before execution.
Expected callback kwargs: `state`, `result`.

handleOutputCallbacks.description:
A list of callbacks to execute during the output handling stage. These callbacks can validate,
modify, or extract specific results from the code execution outputs.
Expected callback kwargs: `state`, `result`.

state.description: Used to maintain state between the different callbacks.

title: Manages the lifecycle of `PythonAgentCodeExecutor` callbacks for code execution workflows.
name: Genai.Agent.Dynamic.CodeExecutionCallbackSpec
